annotations.title: Where to file in detailed assessment (CPR 47.4; PD 47 paras 4.1 and 4.2)

description: Says which court office deals with a detailed assessment in England and Wales, from the court named on the case: the local County Court hearing centre or district registry, or the Senior Courts Costs Office (SCCO). Handles the London rule in PD 47 para 4.2, where the request for an assessment hearing (N258) goes to the SCCO on CE-File but the default costs certificate (N254) stays at the local hearing centre.

court.description: The court as it appears on the order, e.g. 'County Court at Wandsworth', 'County Court at Manchester', 'High Court, King's Bench Division, Royal Courts of Justice'.

form.description: N252 (notice of commencement), N254 (request for a default costs certificate) or N258 (request for an assessment hearing). Defaults to N258.
